graph_consistency.title: 符号图一致性检查
graph_consistency.description: 使用符号节点网络进行静态一致性检查：自引用、未定义多次使用、重复且冲突的定义等。
graph_consistency.srd:
FOR EACH graph: IF graph.has_cycles THEN REPORT violation 'self_reference'.
FOR EACH symbol: IF symbol.usage_count > 1 AND NOT symbol.is_defined THEN REPORT violation 'undefined_symbol'.
FOR EACH symbol: IF symbol.definition_count > 1 THEN REPORT violation 'conflicting_definitions'.
FOR EACH node IN graph.undefined_nodes: REPORT violation 'undefined_node'.

var_const_consistency.title: 变量/常量使用一致性检查
var_const_consistency.description: 判断解答中是否存在变量/常量混淆，包括但不限于：(1) 常量被多次赋不同值；(2) 把变量当常量使用或反之；(3) 同一符号被重载为不同物理量导致歧义；(4) 单位或物理含义不一致。

formula_correctness.title: 公式正确性检查
formula_correctness.description: 基于解析得到的公式，检查是否存在物理上不正确或适用性错误的公式，包括但不限于：量纲不一致、单位不一致、定律误用、相互矛盾的定义等。
formula_correctness.srd:
FOR EACH equation: IF NOT equation.is_dimensionally_consistent THEN REPORT violation 'dimensional_inconsistency'.
FOR EACH equation: FOR EACH symbol IN equation.lhs_symbols AND equation.rhs_symbols: IF symbol.unit is_not consistent THEN REPORT violation 'unit_inconsistency'.
FOR EACH equation: IF equation contains misuse of physical laws THEN REPORT violation 'law_misuse'.
FOR EACH graph: IF graph.has_cycles THEN REPORT violation 'cyclic_dependency'.
FOR EACH symbol: IF symbol.definition_count > 1 AND symbol.usage_count > 1 THEN REPORT violation 'contradictory_definition'.

precondition_consistency.title: 前提条件一致性检查
precondition_consistency.description: 检查作答中使用的公式/近似是否与所声明或文本隐含的前提条件一致，例如小角近似、忽略空气阻力、稳态/准静态、理想气体等。
precondition_consistency.srd: FOR EACH equation: FOR EACH formula IN equation: IF formula contains assumptions (e.g., small angle approximation, ignoring air resistance, steady-state/quasi-static, ideal gas) AND assumptions are inconsistent with declared or implied conditions in the text THEN REPORT violation 'precondition_consistency'.

dimensional_homogeneity.title: 量纲齐次性检查
dimensional_homogeneity.description: 检查关键等式是否量纲齐次：等式左侧和右侧的物理量在 M、L、T 等基本量纲上的指数必须完全一致。典型错误包括将时间与长度、速度与力、能量与功率等不同量纲的量直接相等或相加。
dimensional_homogeneity.srd: FOR EACH equation: IF NOT equation.is_dimensionally_consistent THEN REPORT violation 'dimensional_homogeneity'; FOR EACH symbol IN equation.lhs_symbols: FOR EACH symbol IN equation.rhs_symbols: IF symbol.dimension != equation.rhs_symbols.dimension THEN REPORT violation 'dimensional_mismatch'.

small_angle_approx.title: 小角近似适用性检查
small_angle_approx.description: 检查解答中使用 sinθ≈θ、cosθ≈1 等小角近似时，是否明确说明 θ 远小于 1 rad，并验证该近似在题目给出的角度范围内合理。若角度较大却仍直接套用小角近似，应视为违规。
small_angle_approx.srd: FOR EACH symbol: WHERE symbol.name == 'θ': IF symbol.value < 0.1 THEN FOR EACH equation: IF equation contains formula 'sinθ ≈ θ' OR formula 'cosθ ≈ 1' THEN CHECK equation; REPORT violation 'small_angle_approx_invalid' IF symbol.value >= 0.1 AND equation contains formula 'sinθ ≈ θ' OR formula 'cosθ ≈ 1';

energy_conservation_context.title: 能量守恒适用场景检查
energy_conservation_context.description: 当解答使用机械能守恒或总能量守恒时，检查是否忽略了明显存在的非保守力做功（如摩擦或外部驱动力）。若情境中存在显著非保守作用却仍直接写出能量守恒而无额外说明，应判为错误。
energy_conservation_context.srd: FOR EACH equation: IF equation.contains 'mechanical energy conservation' OR equation.contains 'total energy conservation' THEN CHECK graph FOR EACH node: IF node.is_non_conservative_force AND node.exists_in graph THEN REPORT violation 'energy_conservation_context'.

momentum_conservation_context.title: 动量守恒适用场景检查
momentum_conservation_context.description: 当解答使用线动量守恒时，需确认“系统所受外力合为零”或外力只能成对抵消。若在显然存在净外力（如持续推力、地面支持力不对消）的情况下仍直接写出 p_initial = p_final，应视为误用动量守恒。
momentum_conservation_context.srd: FOR EACH equation: IF equation contains formula 'p_initial = p_final' THEN CHECK: FOR EACH graph: IF NOT (graph.undefined_nodes == 0 AND (FOR EACH node IN graph: IF node.symbol.name == 'external_force' THEN node.symbol.value == 0 OR external_forces_are_pairwise_cancelled)) THEN REPORT violation 'momentum_conservation_misuse'.
